_comment_ignoreCommand: Exit 0 skips the build, exit 1 runs it. This skips any commit that
touched nothing outside journal/ - the agent commits its journal every
ten minutes while trading, and none of it is read from the bundle:
api/journal.py fetches it live from the GitHub contents API. Those
commits were rebuilding and storing the whole deployment for nothing.
If HEAD^ cannot be resolved the || branch runs and the build proceeds,
so an unexpected repository state deploys rather than silently skipping.
